instruction: Configure Playwright so failures are visible, reproducible and cannot be silenced
context: CI must reject committed .only, retry transient failures, and keep artifacts for diagnosis. Options such as webServer and storageState are valid only when the suite starts its own app or needs a shared login; they are judged against the project's profile, not required.

checklist.name: ci-retries
checklist.rule: retries is configured for CI and is not zero everywhere

checklist.name: diagnostic-artifacts
checklist.rule: Debugging best practice: failure artifacts are all captured: trace is on-first-retry or retain-on-failure (not always on), screenshot is only-on-failure, and video is retain-on-failure

checklist.name: parallelism-intentional
checklist.rule: fullyParallel is enabled, or the config explains why tests share state and must run serially

checklist.name: base-url
checklist.rule: baseURL is configured (literal or from an environment helper) so tests use relative paths

checklist.name: ci-reporter
checklist.rule: A reporter that CI can consume (junit, html or json) is configured

checklist.name: app-startup-fits-environment
checklist.rule: webServer is configured when tests run against a locally started app; deployed-environment suites state their target through baseURL and do not need it
